about_the_game:
Welcome to The Six, a magical world where dice define your identity. You’re an adventurer trapped in a timeloop with a chaotic, impish DM. Beneath the surface, a dungeon morphs and shifts every day, hiding secrets and relics that will be the key to your escape.

Beneath The Six is a roguelike experience with a single randomized daily dungeon and 4-player co-op. Collect sets of dice and use them to create and blend fighters, mages or rogues to beat the DM’s daily challenges. Earn rewards to unlock more dice sets, build your collection by trading with friends and, one day, perhaps, escape The Six.

Conquer The Daily Dungeon

The daily dungeon regenerates every 24 hours with new challenges, enemies, secrets and loot, and different dungeons will suit different characters. Your challenge: find the right build for today’s adventure!

Collect Dice

Conquer daily and weekly challenges to unlock the distinct dice that will define your character. Each set holds its own stats, weapons, and skills: combine them to craft diverse and fearsome champions. Show off your builds and trade dice — and build strategies — with friends, or quest together to seek out Refined or Master rarities; perhaps even whisper a prayer to the Gods of The Six for something… Legendary?

Unique Character Creator

Use your dice sets to create unique characters with differing skills, armors, weapons and stats to take on the dungeon. Each dice in a set provides a specific component to your character so you can mix and match them.

Survive The Daily Arena

Test your build in our brutal arena mode, where each wave gets increasingly difficult, with higher tiered enemies and near-impossible intensity. The arena resets every 24 hours. Compete with your friends for the top spot on the leaderboard!

Party Up And Explore With Friends

Beneath The Six supports 4-player co-op, allowing you to tackle the dangers of the dungeon and arena with backup, and show off your new characters.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM

short_description: Beneath The Six is a traditional roguelike set in a fractured world long-forgotten by space and time. Collect powerful dice sets, use them to forge valiant adventurers and explore daily randomized dungeons full of trinkets, traps and treasures.
